public_body: Hadley Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when two members deliberated by email on December 17 and 18, 2022, rejecting the argument that merely sharing information from DHCD was exempt; ordered future compliance and release of the emails.

allegations.summary: Alleged that two board members deliberated by email on December 17 and 18, 2022, outside a noticed meeting, about the status of a housing authority contract.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that Mr. Allen and Mr. Chadwick violated the Open Meeting Law when they deliberated via email on December 17 and 18.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.

Publicly release the December 17 and 18, 2022 emails within 30 days of receipt of the determination, if not already done, by reading them at a meeting and listing them in the minutes, or by referencing them at a meeting and posting them with the minutes on the municipal website.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
